+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML elements in Windows stderr, preserving other bytes."""
+    headers = []
+    offset = 0
+    previous_crlf = False
+    for line in stderr.splitlines(keepends=True):
+        for marker in (b"#< CLIXML\r\n", b"<# CLIXML\r\n"):
+            start = line.find(marker)
+            while start != -1:
+                headers.append((offset + start, offset + start + len(marker)))
+                start = line.find(marker, start + len(marker))
+
+        if previous_crlf and line.startswith(b"CLIXML\r\n"):
+            headers.append((offset, offset + len(b"CLIXML\r\n")))
+
+        offset += len(line)
+        previous_crlf = line.endswith(b"\r\n")
+
+    if not headers:
+        return stderr
+
+    result = bytearray()
+    cursor = 0
+    for start, header_end in sorted(headers):
+        if start < cursor:
+            continue
+
+        xml_start = stderr.find(b"<Objs ", header_end)
+        if xml_start == -1 or stderr[header_end:xml_start].strip() not in (b"", b"#< CLIXML", b"<# CLIXML"):
+            continue
+
+        first_end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", xml_start)
+        if first_end == -1:
+            continue
+        xml_end = first_end + len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        try:
+            block = stderr[start:xml_end]
+            try:
+                block = block.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                block = block.decode("cp437").encode("utf-8")
+            decoded = _parse_clixml(block)
+        except (SyntaxError, ValueError, UnicodeError, LookupError):
+            continue
+
+        # PowerShell can emit several adjacent Objs elements under one header.
+        # Let the parser join their messages with the same separator it uses
+        # for a CLIXML stream received on its own.
+        while stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", xml_end):
+            next_end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", xml_end)
+            if next_end == -1:
+                break
+            next_end += len(b"</Objs>")
+            try:
+                next_block = stderr[start:next_end]
+                try:
+                    next_block = next_block.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-8")
+                except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                    next_block = next_block.decode("cp437").encode("utf-8")
+                next_decoded = _parse_clixml(next_block)
+            except (SyntaxError, ValueError, UnicodeError, LookupError):
+                break
+            decoded = next_decoded
+            xml_end = next_end
+
+        result.extend(stderr[cursor:start])
+        result.extend(decoded)
+        cursor = xml_end
+
+    result.extend(stderr[cursor:])
+    return bytes(result)
+

+    (b'bad #< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">incomplete',
+     b'bad #< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">incomplete'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">invalid</Objs>',
+     b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">invalid</Objs>'),
+    (_clixml(b'caf\x82'), 'café'.encode()),
+    (_clixml(b'one') + b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">two</S></Objs>', b'one\r\ntwo'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">one</S></Objs>'
+     b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">invalid</Objs>',
+     b'one<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">invalid</Objs>'),
+    (b'prefix\r\nCLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">bare</S></Objs>suffix', b'prefix\r\nbaresuffix'),
+])
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml(stderr, expected):
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(stderr) == expected
+
+
+def test_windows_exec_command_replaces_embedded_clixml():
+    conn = ssh.Connection(PlayContext(), StringIO())
+    conn._shell = MagicMock(_IS_WINDOWS=True)
+    conn.get_option = MagicMock(return_value='host')
+    conn._build_command = MagicMock(return_value='ssh command')
+    conn._run = MagicMock(return_value=(1, b'', b'prefix ' + _clixml(b'failure') + b' suffix'))
+
+    assert conn.exec_command('command') == (1, b'', b'prefix failure suffix')
+
+
